snippet.title: Eagle Knight Paradox — Out Sept 21 🤖
snippet.description:
🎮 Wishlist EKP now on Steam bit.ly/EKPtrailerYT 🤖 

Protect the city or risk it all for those you love?
Comala 88 is a neon-lit city still carrying the scars of war, and you're the one thing standing between it and the dark. By day, live as Ian: walk the streets, forge bonds, and witness how those scars ripple through everyday life. By night, climb into your towering combat mecha and face colossal enemies in frantic, skill-based battles. Every choice you make shapes what's left of the city, and who's still in it.

High-speed mecha combat that hits hard
Colossal enemies. Split-second timing. Suit up and go save Comala 88.

A cyberpunk graphic novel with real consequences
Explore Comala 88's streets and murals, and meet its residents. Every conversation, every decision changes what's waiting for you.

Ian: a boy by day, a hero by night
A boy with the lost dream of becoming an Eagle Knight pilot. Now, Comala 88 is offering him something he thought was gone for good. Today, he's the only one standing between the city and the darkness.

A city of rivals, legends, and unlikely allies
Ian won't go throught this journey alone. Captain Rojas, a young commander of a legendary frigate with much to prove, takes a risk supporting Ian. Kaitlyn, his closest friend since childhood, has now a shocking new role that will make Ian question everything.

A hand-drawn story, told in about two hours
A story created and hand drawn frame by frame by a solo artist, crafted alongside a small team who channeled their love for games into every scene. No filler, nothing extra, just every scene made to count.
